articles.summary: H.B. Fuller Company (NYSE: FUL) announced plans to report its financial results for the three-month fiscal period ended August 29, 2026, in a press release issued after the market close on September 23, 2026. The Company will hold an investor conference call on September 24, 2026, at 9:30 a.m. CT (10:30 a.m. ET) to discuss its financial results. Interested parties may listen to the conference call on a live webcast. The webcast, along with a supplemental presentation, may be accessed from the company’s website at https://investors.hbfuller.com . Participants must register prior to accessing the webcast using this link and should do so at least 10 minutes prior to the start of the call to install and test any necessary software and audio connections. Participants can pre-register for the webcast at any time using the link above. The webcast will be archived on the company’s website. articles.summary: Annual awards recognize Huhtamaki and Bin Dasmal for breakthrough solutions made possible through collaboration H.B. Fuller (NYSE: FUL), the world's largest pureplay adhesives provider, today announced Bin Dasmal General Trading Co. and Huhtamaki as recipients of its 2026 Customer Innovation Award. From reducing plastic in food packaging to improving the durability of critical infrastructure, this year's H.B. Fuller Customer Innovation Award winners are solving some of the world's most complex manufacturing challenges. The annual awards recognize customers who have developed solutions delivering measurable advances in sustainability, safety, performance or operational efficiency. articles.summary: New portfolio builds on proven 4SG technology to deliver revolutionary insulating glass performance and durability. H.B. Fuller (NYSE: FUL), the world’s largest pureplay adhesives company, today announced the launch of Kōfinity™, a new product portfolio platform built on the company's proven 4SG technology and created to advance innovation in insulating glass (IG) solutions while maintaining the durability and long-term performance customers have come to expect from 4SG. Window seal failure is one of the leading causes of home and building owner complaints, resulting in fogging, condensation, and reduced thermal performance in IG units. Building on the global success of H.B. Fuller’s existing 4SG reactive thermoplastic spacer technology, the new Kōfinity portfolio reestablishes this technology under an elevated category of fusion bonded spacers while creating a platform for new cutting-edge IG innovations engineered for durability, energy-efficiency and long-term performance.
articles.title: H.B. Fuller Introduces Kōfinity™ Portfolio Featuring Fusion Bonded Spacers, Providing Maximum Performance in Window Seal Reliability
